newsitem.title: USA: Texaco names Sr. VP Black upstream chief.
newsitem.headline: Texaco names Sr. VP Black upstream chief.

text.p: Texaco Inc said Wednesday its realigned worldwide upstream functions will be directed by C. Robert Black, 61, senior vice president of Texaco Inc, who will be named President of Texaco Worldwide Exploration and Production.
As a member of the senior executive team, Black will be located in Harrison, N.Y. The four upstream operating units will be based in Houston, Texaco said.
Worldwide Exploration will be headed by Bruce S. Appelbaum, 49, currently president of the International Exploration Division, who will be named President of Texaco Exploration.

International Producing will be headed by Robert A. Solberg, 50, currently vice president of Texaco Inc and president of Texaco's Middle East/Far East Division. Solberg will be named President of Texaco International Production.

North American Producing will be led by Claire S. Farley, 37, currently managing director and chief executive of Hydro-Texaco Holdings. Farley will be named President of Texaco North America Production and has been elected a Vice President of Texaco Inc effective January 1.

New Business Development in the upstream area will be headed by Thomas L. Hazen, 52, now president and chief executive of Timan Pechora Co. Hazen will be named Vice President of Texaco Exploration and Production New Business Development. -- Jim Brumm 212-859-1710.
